request: Monthly forecast of Tito's minis in Des Moines for the next 5 months
title: Tito's minis, Des Moines, next 5 months
summary: Tito's Minis (50ml) in Des Moines are forecast at 3,410 bottles over the next five months, up 10% versus the same months last year (3,090 bottles). Growth is led by November and January, each up roughly 24-25% year over year, while September and October look close to flat. The model is 11% more accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline in backtesting, though errors still run around 35% by month, so treat this as a directional guide rather than a precise number. No series were skipped or left unvalidated in this forecast.

request: What revenue should we expect from Fireball in Linn County next quarter?
title: Fireball, Linn County, next quarter
summary: Fireball sales in Linn County are forecast at about $553,000 over the next quarter, down 4% from the same months last year ($578,000). The dip is led by September, projected down 11%, while November is expected to run 4% above last year. Backtesting shows the model is 9% more accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline across all three forecast months, so it can be reasonably trusted for near-term planning. No series were skipped or left unvalidated.

request: American vodka sales dollars for each of the five largest counties, next 6 months
title: American vodka dollars, top 5 counties, next 6 months
summary: American vodka sales across the top 5 counties are forecast at about $15.3 million over the next six months, roughly flat (+1%) versus the same months last year's $15.2 million. Monthly results are mixed, with November standing out at +10% versus last year while September and January dip slightly (-2%). Backtesting shows this model is about 4% less accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline, and it tends to underperform that baseline at the 4- and 6-month horizons, so treat the later months with some caution. Polk county dominates the forecast at roughly $6.86 million of the total.

request: Forecast ready-to-drink cocktail bottles statewide for the next 6 months
title: Ready-to-drink cocktails, statewide, next 6 months
summary: Statewide ready-to-drink cocktail sales over the next six months are forecast at about 247,000 bottles, down 19% from the 307,000 bottles sold in the same months last year, with declines ranging from about 12% to 26% month to month. Backtesting shows the model is roughly 2% less accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline overall, performing better than the baseline in the near term (months 1 and 2) but falling behind in later months (4 through 6), so treat the later months of this forecast with more caution. No series were skipped or left unvalidated.

request: Total liters of liquor sold statewide over the next 12 months
title: Statewide total liters, next 12 months
summary: Statewide volume over the next 12 months is forecast at about 21.1 million liters, down 2% from the same months last year's 21.5 million liters. Monthly changes range from small gains like +2% in March and August to declines of -6% in October and July. In backtesting, the model was 4% less accurate than a simple seasonal-naive baseline overall, performing on par or better through the first six months ahead but noticeably worse than the baseline from 9 to 12 months out, so nearer-term months should be trusted more than the tail end of the forecast. No series were flagged as unvalidated or skipped.
